dct_description_sm: A quantitative gamma-ray spectrometric and aeromagnetic helicopter-borne geophysical survey was completed by Fugro Airborne Surveys. The survey was flown from September 10 to October 14, 2008. The nominal traverse and control line spacings were 400m and 2400m respectively, and the aircraft flew at a nominal terrain clearance of 125m. Traverse lines were oriented at 0 degrees with orthogonal control lines.
dct_title_s: Geophysical Series, NTS 115K/1, Airborne Geophysical Survey Southern Stevenson Ridge area, Yukon
